feedback.problem: What is the trace in the $xz$-plane of the sphere $(x-2)^{2}+{y}^{2}+(z+2)^{2}=16?$
feedback.worked_solution:
To find the trace in the $xz$-plane, we substitute $y=0$ into the equation of the sphere:

$$
\begin{aligned}(x-2)^{2}+(0)^{2}+(z+2)^{2} & =16 \\ (x-2)^{2}+(z+2)^{2} & =16\end{aligned}
$$
